challenges.name: order-events-queue-backpressure
challenges.title: Load the order events through a bounded queue
challenges.description: Rice Rocket's loader reads order events from the stream about ten times faster than the warehouse can write them. With an unbounded `asyncio.Queue` the buffer grew until the pod was OOMKilled; after a fix, one refused event made the loader hang forever on `queue.join()`; another version returned early and dropped the events still in the buffer. The editor holds `run_pipeline` with its key blocks missing, each marked by a `# [ ]` line; some pieces are wrong on purpose. Fill every line so that at most `maxsize` events wait in the buffer, `workers` writers run concurrently, a refused event goes to the dead-letter list, and the function returns only after every event read is written or dead-lettered, with no writer left running. Run streams the events on a simulated clock and reports the most events held in memory at once, the dead letters, the time and the tasks left over.
hints: Follow one refused event: who calls `queue.task_done()` for it? `queue.join()` waits until every `put` has a matching `task_done`.

Look at `asyncio.Queue(maxsize=...)` (its `put` waits while the queue is full: that is the backpressure), `try/except/finally` in the worker loop, and stopping workers that wait on `get()` forever: `join()` first, then `task.cancel()` and `gather(..., return_exceptions=True)`.

A thumbnail pipeline: `q = asyncio.Queue(maxsize=20)`; `async def worker(): while True: photo = await q.get(); try: await resize(photo) except ResizeError: failed.append(photo) finally: q.task_done()`; start 3 workers; `async for p in uploads: await q.put(p)`; then `await q.join()`, cancel the workers and gather them.

tests.name: 20 events: all written, no writer left running
1,000 events from a fast stream: memory stays bounded by the buffer
Two events refused by the warehouse: dead-lettered, the loader finishes
One writer and a buffer of 5: still bounded, still complete
An empty stream: returns at once and leaves nothing running
